transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… it’s what happens after I eat like that. I end up sitting there looking at all the empty containers, and I just feel disgusted with myself. Like I’m not the steady, in-control man I’ve always tried to be.
Do you often eat a large amount of food in a short period of time?

Yeah… some evenings. I’ll tell myself I’m just heating up one bowl of pozole, and then somehow I’ve gone through the pot… maybe a couple tamales, chips, whatever leftovers are there. It’s like I’m eating for a whole crew, not just me.
Do you usually feel guilty after eating a large amount of food in a short period of time?
Yeah. I do. I’ll sit there afterward, looking at all the empty containers, and… I feel pretty disgusted with myself. Like I should’ve had control, and I didn’t.
Do you try to get rid of the calories after you eat a large amount of food in a short period of time?
I… don’t really know what you mean by that. I don’t think I do anything like that, not that I’ve noticed.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after eating?
No… I don’t make myself throw up. Not on purpose.
Do you ever exercise excessively after eating a large amount of food?
Not really. I mean… I don’t go work out hard or anything after. I’m usually just sitting there, feeling bad.
Do you ever fast or severely restrict your food intake after eating a large amount of food in a short period of time?
I don’t think so. I might not feel like eating much right after, but I don’t… set out to not eat or anything like that.
Do you find that this kind of eating happens to you regularly?
Yeah… pretty regularly. Since I’ve been home with my back injury, it’s been several nights most weeks. I don’t think there’s been a week in the last three months where it didn’t happen at least once.
Do you usually eat this way when you're feeling stressed or upset?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes. I haven’t really paid attention to whether it’s stress or being upset. It just kind of happens.
Do you think you eat this way when you're feeling upset or emotional?
I’m not really sure. I mean, maybe sometimes, but I can’t say I’ve noticed a clear connection with being emotional.
How many times a week do you usually eat a large amount of food in a short period of time?
Usually several nights a week… since I’ve been home with my back injury. I can’t really think of any week in the last three months where it didn’t happen at least once.
Do you think your emotional state has anything to do with why you eat a large amount of food in a short period of time?
I don’t really know. I haven’t paid close enough attention to say it’s because of how I’m feeling. It just sort of happens, I guess.
Do you think your eating a large amount of food in a short period of time is usually triggered by feeling emotional?
I can’t really say it’s usually from being emotional. I mean, maybe sometimes, but I haven’t noticed a pattern like that.
Do you feel like you're unable to stop eating or control how much you're eating when these episodes happen?

Yeah… I guess that’s the part that bothers me. Once I start, it’s like the discipline I used to have on the road just shuts off. I’ll be telling myself, “Magin, put the fork down,” but my hand just keeps going back.
Do you feel like you're unable to control what you're eating during these episodes?
Yeah. I mean… once I start, it doesn’t feel like I’m really choosing anymore. I’ll tell myself to stop, like, “Magin, put the fork down,” but my hand just keeps going back.
Do you feel like you're eating much more quickly than usual during these episodes?
Yeah… I do. I eat fast, like I’m trying to make some delivery window or something. Half the time I’m barely tasting it, just shoveling it in, and then I’ll notice I’m breathing hard.
